recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; the current spec already conveys the approved clarification and further local wording would be redundant with the existing Expression Language and Expression sections.
issue_request: FHIR-13587 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking that ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition dynamicValue examples in the Using Expressions topic specify the expression language and that the multiple-library example use a FHIR object path rather than putting the library qualifier in the path.
initial_application: Git-svn commit fe9a278da48fa5f1e5fac3ca1bc517fafd96b8e2 (SVN 13322, cited in the Jira comment) added language declarations to the relevant examples and changed the qualified example to path value="reasonCode" with the library qualifier in the expression value.
additional_context: The former CQIF Using Expressions content is now source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html and is included by the Clinical Reasoning hierarchy/module page. Later related work refined the same example family: FHIR-16708 added quote-escaping guidance and a JSON example, FHIR-35981 corrected CQL media types, FHIR-49976 and FHIR-53080 updated the Using Expressions guidance, and FHIR-49246 corrected the encoded suicide-risk library content without changing this path/language issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already has language values for the relevant CQL examples, keeps dynamicValue.path as reasonCode, puts the mmi-suiciderisk-orderset-logic qualifier in the expression, and no longer contains the stale mmi-suiciderisk-orderset-logic.reasonCode path in the relevant source.
